description:
subscribers.ex:47 calls Registry.lookup then manually splits and iterates. Replace with Registry.dispatch/3 which holds no lock between lookup and iteration — correct under concurrent unregistration.

Before:
  listeners = Registry.lookup(@registry, session_pid)
  {sync, async} = Enum.split_with(listeners, ...)
  Enum.each(sync, ...)
  Enum.each(async, ...)

After:
  Registry.dispatch(@registry, session_pid, fn entries ->
    {sync, async} = Enum.split_with(entries, fn {_pid, {_l, mode}} -> mode == :sync end)
    Enum.each(sync, ...)
    Enum.each(async, ...)
  end)
title: Registry.dispatch/3 in Subscribers.dispatch
